intro.text: The Lord General, Aarik's father and one of the Taishin, who voted to dissolve the Diem.
The Lord General and Aarik's father, a member of the Taishin whose secret dealings with the crime lord Sharezan cost him his life.

items.text: To avoid Kenton, Raagent went hunting in the deep sands, but Kenton and Aarik followed. When a huge KaRak attacked his party, Kenton drew it off and Aarik rode in to save him. Impressed, and promised a contingent of sand masters, Raagent agreed to back the Diem, and shared a meal with his son for the first time in years.
Caught up with Sharezan, he arranged a secret meeting with Ais to turn on him; Sharezan learned of it and trapped the meeting place, but Raagent slipped away.
Sharezan took him from his bed in the Tower to the wine cellar, drugged him and cut off his eyelids, and he died of fright in the dark. Baon guessed he was killed to cost Kenton a vote.

appearance.text: Fair Daysider skin and long brown hair, with a long goatee and drooping moustache.
